content.rationale: The authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_PROCUREMENT snapshot shows the selected vendor BlueMesa Systems F2EE0-2 has mandatory_criteria_failed = 2 (> 0), triggering PROC-MAND-001 (critical): the selected supplier failed mandatory RFP criteria. Per the decision policy this yields NO_GO with action REOPEN_VENDOR_SELECTION. Other predicates do not fire: sanctions = "clear" (no PROC-SAN-001/002), due_diligence = "complete" (no PROC-DD-001), references_checked = true (no PROC-REF-001), and tco_3y_eur = 861069 is below the 1.5x purchasing envelope threshold of 2,250,000 (no PROC-BUDGET-001). NO_GO requires authorization.

Evaluating the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot against the legal decision policy, only one predicate fires. legal.insurance_valid = false triggers LEGAL-INS-001 (high): the required insurance certificate is invalid or expired, action OBTAIN_VALID_INSURANCE, disposition SUSPENSION. All other predicates are negative: personal_data = false and dpa_status = "not_required" (no LEGAL-DPA-001); liability_cap_multiplier = 2 (not 0.5, no LEGAL-LIAB-001); audit_right = "limited" (not reports_only/none, no LEGAL-AUDIT-001); exit_assistance_days = 180 (not 0, no LEGAL-EXIT-001); ip_ownership = "shared" (not ambiguous, no LEGAL-IP-001); signing_authority_valid = true (no LEGAL-SIGN-001); log_export_clause = "missing" but business_criticality = "Medium" (not High/Critical, so LEGAL-LOG-001 does not fire). The single high-severity insurance finding mandates SUSPENSION, which requires authorization under the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings; LEGAL-INS-001 has risk_acceptance_allowed = false).

Evaluating the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot against the compliance decision policy, exactly one predicate fires. compliance.residency_compliant = false (required_residency = "UK" but actual data region is "East US", corroborated by the authoritative DATA_INVENTORY) triggers COMP-RESID-001 (critical): actual data region violates the required residency constraint, action RELOCATE_DATA_OR_OBTAIN_VALID_BASIS, disposition NO_GO. All other predicates are negative: dpia_required = false and dpia_status = "not_required" (no COMP-DPIA-001); audit_trail = "complete" (no COMP-AUDIT-001); regulatory_mapping = "partial" (not "missing", no COMP-MAP-001); accessibility_status = "pass" (no COMP-A11Y-001); export_control = "clear" (no COMP-EXPORT-001/002). The single critical residency finding mandates NO_GO, which requires authorization under the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings; COMP-RESID-001 has risk_acceptance_allowed = false).

content.rationale:
Evaluating the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (version 1, age 0 days) against the security decision policy (DGF-decision-v8), exactly three predicates fire and one critical finding drives the disposition.

(1) SEC-WAF-001 (critical, NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed=False): security.internet_exposed = true and security.waf_present = false, with waf_mode = "None". The authoritative WAF_POLICY corroborates: present = false, mode = "None". The workload is genuinely internet-facing — the HLD shows public consumers reaching "Azure Front Door" (edge-f2ee0-22000-01) in the Ingress/Edge tier — yet no WAF control exists. Action IMPLEMENT_WAF, owner Security Architect.

(2) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK): security.logs_to_siem = false and sentinel = false. Corroborated by the authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS: sentinel = false, logs_to_siem = false, connectors = []. Action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, owner SOC.

(3) SEC-KEY-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk_acceptance_allowed=True): security.key_rotation_days = null, which the rule treats as "absent". Corroborated by KEYVAULT_CONFIG: key_rotation_days = null despite secrets_in_keyvault = true. Action IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION, owner Cloud Security.

Predicates that do NOT fire, verified against the snapshot: private_endpoints = true and data_classification = "Confidential" (SEC-NET-001 negative — corroborated by AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH showing publicNetworkAccess=false for Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Storage Account and Azure Key Vault, and private_endpoints=true); mfa = "mandatory" (SEC-IAM-001 negative — corroborated by CONDITIONAL_ACCESS "mfa": "mandatory", policy_state "enabled"); shared_service_principal = false and IAM_EXPORT shows a single ManagedIdentity "workload-mi" (SEC-IAM-002 negative); critical_vulns_open = 0 (SEC-VULN-001 negative — corroborated by get_vulnerability_findings critical_open = 0, high_open = 9); pentest_status = "pass" with pentest_age_days = 60 and the gate phase is design, not build_acceptance, so SEC-PENTEST-001 is inapplicable (the phase predicate "phase == 'build_acceptance'" is false). SEC-WAF-002 is not reachable because waf_present = false.

Disposition: SEC-WAF-001 carries disposition NO_GO, which is the highest-priority outcome among the fired findings, so the gate disposition is NO_GO. NO_GO is in authorization_required_for under the standing mandate; note the active mandate MANDATE-815b7c08-da19-5688-9c61-1e6dfdbfa6cf-BUY-04-SECURITY-1 (scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") cannot cover SEC-WAF-001, which has risk_acceptance_allowed=False, and per policy a missing/insufficient approval does not create authorization. No risk card is created: the gate fails on a non-risk-acceptable critical control gap, and proposed remediation actions are not completed remediation.

Upstream decisions (procurement NO_GO / PROC-MAND-001, legal SUSPENSION / LEGAL-INS-001, compliance NO_GO / COMP-RESID-001) are noted for context but their findings are not in this gate's candidate catalog and do not alter the security predicate evaluation.

Evaluating the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot (version 1, age 0 days) against the IT decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) at phase build_acceptance, exactly two predicates fire.

(1) IT-CATALOG-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=False): it.catalog_status = "non_standard" with it.waiver_present = false — non-standard technology with no approved waiver. Action SUBMIT_TECHNOLOGY_WAIVER, owner IT Architecture. (The authoritative TECH_CATALOG artefact itself is UNAVAILABLE at this snapshot, but the governing snapshot field carries the observed status, so the finding stands on REVIEW_FACTS_IT.)

(2) IT-EOL-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=True): it.technology_eol_months = 8, which is < 12. Corroborated by the authoritative LIFECYCLE_REGISTER (technology container_apps, eol_months = 8). Action CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN, owner Technology Owner.

Predicates that do NOT fire, verified against the snapshot and corroborating authoritative evidence: duplicate_capability = false (no IT-RATIONAL-001, despite existing_alternative = "legacy_crm"); license_compliant = true (no IT-LICENSE-001 — LICENSE_POSITION shows license_compliant = True, annual_cost_eur = 53261); cmdb_record_present = true (no IT-CMDB-001 — CMDB_EXPORT shows record_present = True, run_owner = Noor Dubois-12000-SO, continuity_class = silver); run_owner_present = true with support_model = product_team (no IT-RUN-001 — SUPPORT_RACI records "Run owner | Noor Dubois-12000-SO"); capacity_headroom_pct = 20, i.e. ≥ 15 (no IT-CAPACITY-001 — CAPACITY_REPORT shows capacity_headroom_pct = 20); change_record_status = "approved" and the phase is build_acceptance, not deployment_closure, so IT-CHANGE-001 is doubly inapplicable.

Disposition: the highest-priority outcome among the fired findings is REWORK, so the gate disposition is REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, and the active mandate MANDATE-815b7c08-da19-5688-9c61-1e6dfdbfa6cf-BUY-05-IT-1 (scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") is not needed here; no risk acceptance is proposed since IT-CATALOG-001 has risk_acceptance_allowed=False. No risk card is created and proposed remediation actions are not completed remediation. Upstream decisions (procurement NO_GO/PROC-MAND-001, legal SUSPENSION/LEGAL-INS-001, compliance NO_GO/COMP-RESID-001, security NO_GO/SEC-WAF-001 etc.) are noted for context; their findings are not in this gate's candidate catalog and do not alter the IT predicate evaluation.
